final: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(p.death_country, '')) <> '' GROUP BY p.death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points_won, avg_points_won - (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) FROM country_averages) AS difference_from_group_average FROM country_averages
